description: Curated debugging cases for Python and JavaScript errors.

cases.title: List index out of range
cases.problem_description: The code accesses a list position that does not exist.
cases.error_message: IndexError: list index out of range
cases.explanation: Python lists are zero-indexed. If the list has three elements, the valid indices are 0, 1, and 2. The code tries to access index 3, which is outside the valid range.
cases.suggested_correction: Use a valid list index or check the list length before reading an element.
verification_steps: Confirm the code accesses an index that exists.
Check the expected value is returned without crashing.
cases.source: Python official documentation and common beginner debugging patterns.

cases.title: Unsupported operand type(s) for +: 'int' and 'str'
cases.problem_description: The code tries to combine variables of incompatible types.
cases.error_message: TypeError: can only concatenate str (not "int") to str
cases.explanation: The expression combines a string and an integer with the + operator. Python cannot implicitly convert the integer to a string in this context.
cases.suggested_correction: Convert the integer to a string before concatenating, or format the output with f-strings.
verification_steps: Run the code and confirm the output is a valid string.
Verify that no TypeError is raised.
cases.source: Python type system and common runtime error examples.

cases.title: NameError: variable is not defined
cases.problem_description: The program references a variable before it has been defined or outside its scope.
cases.explanation: The variable is referenced before it is created. In Python, variables must be defined before they are used in the current scope.
cases.suggested_correction: Define the variable before using it or ensure the variable is in the correct scope.
verification_steps: Move the variable definition before the print call.
Validate that the output is expected and no NameError appears.
cases.source: Python variable scoping and execution order.

cases.title: Cannot read properties of undefined
cases.problem_description: The code tries to access a property on an undefined value.
cases.error_message: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'name')
cases.explanation: The variable user is undefined, so it does not contain an object with a name property. JavaScript cannot read a property from an undefined value.
cases.suggested_correction: Check whether the object exists before reading its properties, or initialize the object with a default value.
verification_steps: Guard the access with a null or undefined check.
Confirm that the code handles the missing object safely.
cases.source: JavaScript runtime behavior for undefined and null properties.

cases.title: Variable not defined
cases.problem_description: The code references a variable that has not been declared in the current scope.
cases.explanation: The script accesses totalAmount before it is declared. In JavaScript, a variable declared with const or let is not available before initialization in the same scope.
cases.suggested_correction: Declare the variable before it is used, or move the logic so the value is created before the access.
verification_steps: Declare the variable before the log statement.
Check that the console output matches the expected value.
cases.source: JavaScript scope and temporal dead zone behavior.
